'''Salmon''' are a type of aquatic [[vermin]] found in nearly all [[temperate]] [[ocean]]s and [[river]]s, and are a ready source of [[food]] when [[fish cleaning|cleaned]] at a [[fishery]].

Some [[dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] salmon for their ''beauty''.
